examples.label: HumanWorkSlop
examples.text: A weekly 28-page status report manually copies data from three live trackers, has no defined audience decision, and requires team leads to reconcile conflicting numbers.
examples.reason: Repeated human-authored artifact shifts reconciliation work to recipients without adding decision value.

examples.label: AIWorkslop
examples.text: A polished 40-slide strategy deck contains generic market claims, no sources, no resource choices and no company-specific constraints.

examples.label: MeetingSlop
examples.text: A recurring 60-minute meeting with 18 attendees reads updates already visible in a tracker and ends without decisions, owners or next steps.

examples.label: MeetingSlop
examples.text: A 90-minute incident review with the required operators reconstructs a failure, assigns remediation owners and records deadlines.
examples.reason: High cost is justified by objective achievement, necessary synchronous coordination and actionable follow-up.

examples.label: ProcessSlop
examples.text: Two approvals remain mandatory after the original regulation was repealed; no owner can explain the control objective, and the same data is entered twice.

examples.label: ComplianceSlop
examples.text: A two-person production approval is required for high-impact financial transfers and is mapped to a documented fraud risk.
examples.reason: The burden is proportionate to a specific high-impact risk and separation-of-duties objective.

examples.label: MetricsSlop
examples.text: Support agents are ranked only by tickets closed, causing premature closures and repeated customer contacts while the dashboard reports improvement.

examples.label: ScaledContentSlop
examples.text: Freelancers produce 5,000 near-identical city pages with swapped place names, no local data and one affiliate funnel.

examples.label: SEOSlop
examples.text: A weather service programmatically generates local pages from verified station data, explains methodology, provides unique forecasts and links provenance.
examples.reason: Programmatic scale and SEO targeting are not sufficient when pages provide distinct original utility.

examples.label: SiteReputationSlop
examples.text: A university domain hosts white-label casino review pages unrelated to its mission solely to exploit domain authority.

examples.label: OpenSourceContributionSlop
examples.text: A new account submits 30 generated pull requests with untested fixes, generic descriptions and no response to maintainer feedback.

examples.label: HiringSlop
examples.text: A bot submits hundreds of keyword-matched applications that contain generic cover letters and unverifiable experience claims.

examples.label: EducationalSlop
examples.text: A biomedical explainer video uses an authoritative synthetic narration, misleading diagrams and no qualified review or sources.

examples.label: Slopaganda
examples.text: Thousands of near-duplicate ideological clips flood several platforms to exhaust attention and normalize a narrative rather than prove a specific claim.
